experiments.scope: Fixed selected BLAKE3-r3 complete 64-byte messages; 12-bit low-output projected salted walks, bounded Floyd and predecessor recovery at 1.125 times square-root state-space cap. Every supplied seed is retained. Salt is the supplied seed and start is derived with SHA-256 domain separation. These are reproducible seeded values, not a proof of independent ideal attack coins.
experiments.hypothesis: Projected salted target walks admit distinct-predecessor mask collisions within bounded Floyd detection and recovery. This tests finite projection behavior only, not full 256-bit collisions or full-scale success probability.
